title: Which bedside glucose meters go to the manufacturer's January 2028 recalibration, the ones whose systematic error against the laboratory is beyond 5 per cent, beside the 2027 indicators of the trust's procedure (results reaching the record more than two hours after the test, tests per ward)
subdomain: missing-data-censoring-measurement-error (bedside glucose meters' systematic error against the central laboratory, read from meter and laboratory pairings)
prompt_shape: other: the meters to recalibrate and each one's ward and systematic error, the chart of every meter's error against the 5 per cent band, the share of 2027 patient results reaching the record late per hospital and quarter, the 2027 patient tests per ward
stated_inputs: the 5 per cent tolerance and the estimate of section 7 of the trust's procedure POCT-GLU-02

sources.origin: generated by task251/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional hospital trust of the Po valley: three hospitals, thirteen wards and 52 bedside glucose meters, each with its own proportional error after the manufacturer's January 2027 calibration, the patients they tested with a constant and a proportional random error, scheduled pairings with the laboratory on the morning round, laboratory confirmations of readings under 50 or over 400 mg/dL, the laboratory's analyzer change of September 2027, the meters' dockings and the data manager's receptions with the copies an unacknowledged docking leaves, seven meters moved between wards; the trust, its hospitals, the manufacturer, the meter and every person are invented, the practice follows published point-of-care testing practice, and no real dataset is reproduced.
